I'd like to hear from rights and licensing and accessibility so we can work through any concerns before I make my final approval decision. What do we need to discuss?

transcript.text: I completed an on-site accessibility assessment this week, and I need to flag two findings that affect the operating plan. First, the installation can accommodate at most 40 people per session — not the proposed 60 — due to accessibility requirements for mobility equipment and clear circulation paths. Ensure all published visitor materials use the credit wording 'Signal Garden by Nia Okafor'.
Do not record the installation for promotional or any other use, as prohibited by the artist license.
